plugins.name: codacy-skills
plugins.description: Codacy skills for Claude Code: query issues, enrich code reviews, and configure Codacy for your project.

skills.name: codacy-analysis-cli
skills.description: Uses the Codacy Analysis CLI to run local static analysis on repositories or specific files. Handles installation, initialization, dependency management, dry-runs, and analysis with JSON output. Use whenever the user wants to analyze code locally, run static analysis, scan for bugs or security issues, lint files, check code quality without pushing to Codacy, or run tools like ESLint, Ruff, Semgrep, RuboCop, or any other supported analyzer on their machine. Also trigger when the user asks to analyze staged changes, scan a PR locally, or set up local Codacy analysis.
headings: Obtain tokens: Codacy > My Account > Access Management
skills.description_zh: 用 Codacy Analysis CLI 在本地仓库或指定文件运行静态分析，处理安装、初始化、依赖、dry-run 和 JSON 输出，支持 ESLint、Ruff、Semgrep、RuboCop 等及暂存变更/PR 检查，无需推送到 Codacy。

skills.name: codacy-cloud-cli
skills.description: Uses the Codacy Cloud CLI to query repositories, issues, security findings, pull requests, tools, and patterns on Codacy Cloud. Use whenever the user mentions Codacy, asks about code quality metrics, wants to check issues or findings in a repo, inspect a pull request analysis, browse security vulnerabilities, enable or disable tools, search patterns, trigger a reanalysis, or interact with any remote Codacy data — even if they don't say "Codacy CLI" explicitly.
headings: 3. Use the `codacy login` command (with token input)
Obtain tokens: Codacy > My Account > Access Management > Account API Tokens (https://app.codacy.com/account/access-management)
Trigger reanalysis and wait for results (preferred)
skills.description_zh: 通过 Codacy Cloud CLI 查询远程仓库、质量问题、安全发现、PR、工具和模式，查看指标、管理工具、检索规则并触发重新分析。

skills.name: codacy-code-review
skills.description: Enriches pull request code reviews with Codacy data — quality issues, security findings, coverage, and duplication. Use whenever the user asks to review a PR, check what a pull request introduced, verify PR coverage, look at PR quality, or find new issues in a PR. Also use when another code-review skill is active (e.g. CodeRabbit) to layer Codacy data on top. Trigger this skill for any pull request review workflow, even if the user just says "review PR 42" or "what's wrong with this PR".
headings: Step 2: Run local analysis on PR changes
If the PR already exists (compares against the PR's target branch)
If the PR hasn't been created yet (compares against the merge base of the current branch)
Step 3: Fetch Cloud PR data (coverage, quality gate)
Ignore a specific issue in this PR
Ignore all issues Codacy identified as potential false positives in one go
skills.description_zh: 用 Codacy 质量、安全、覆盖率和重复代码数据补充 PR 审查，识别本次新增问题和覆盖率变化，可叠加其他代码审查流程。

skills.name: configure-codacy-cloud
skills.description: Tunes an existing Codacy Cloud repository's configuration directly on the cloud, without local analysis, by importing the current config, suggesting higher-signal tools and patterns, reanalyzing, and iteratively reducing noise across two tuning passes. Requires the repository to already be on Codacy with at least one finished analysis. Uses the Codacy Analysis CLI only for config-file operations and the Codacy Cloud CLI for everything else. Produces a machine-readable JSON summary of pattern, tool, category, and severity changes plus conflicts and recommended path ignores. Use when the user wants to configure or tune Codacy directly on the cloud, reduce noise on a repository already analyzed by Codacy, optimize cloud patterns and tools, or improve the signal of cloud issues without running local analysis.
skills.description_zh: 直接调整已有且至少完成一次分析的 Codacy Cloud 仓库配置，导入配置、选择高信号工具/模式、重分析并分两轮降噪，不运行本地分析；输出规则、工具、类别、严重度、冲突和忽略路径的 JSON 摘要。

skills.name: configure-codacy
skills.description: Tailors Codacy configuration to a project by discovering its stack, enabling the right tools and patterns, running analysis, and intelligently reducing noise — disabling irrelevant or noisy patterns, tuning thresholds, and excluding files that shouldn't be analyzed. Produces a machine-readable summary of all changes. Use whenever the user wants to configure Codacy, reduce noise, fix false positives, enable or disable tools or patterns, tune code quality rules, deal with too many warnings, or align Codacy with their project's conventions. Also trigger when the user complains about irrelevant issues, noisy linters, or wants to set up Codacy for the first time on a repo.
headings: Step 0: Check environment and capture baseline
Delete any existing config first — init --remote refuses to overwrite
Store a copy for later merging and comparison
Run analysis with the Cloud config to capture the BEFORE issue landscape
Record BEFORE issue count and runtime
Store a copy for later merging and comparison
Run analysis with the existing local config
Record BEFORE issue count and runtime
skills.description_zh: 按项目技术栈配置 Codacy 工具与规则，运行分析并关闭无关/高噪规则、调整阈值与排除路径，降低误报并输出全部变更的机器可读摘要。

skills.name: setup-coverage
skills.description: Sets up test coverage reporting in a repository and configures upload to Codacy. Detects testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and coverage gaps, then adds the missing pieces to generate and upload coverage reports. Use whenever the user wants to set up coverage, add coverage reporting, integrate coverage with Codacy, fix missing coverage uploads, troubleshoot coverage not showing up, or configure CI to send coverage data. Also trigger when the user mentions test coverage, code coverage, coverage reports, or wants to know why Codacy shows no coverage for their repo.
headings: At the top of spec/spec_helper.rb or test/test_helper.rb
skills.description_zh: 发现测试框架、CI/CD 和覆盖率缺口，补齐生成与上传报告所需配置，将代码覆盖率接入 Codacy，并诊断报告未显示或上传失败。
